title: EchoBench: Consensus Is Not Corroboration — Measuring Epistemic Arbitration on a Synthetic Social Web
description: Benchmark for epistemic arbitration in web-enabled language models. 100 claims × 6 counterfactual conditions (600 worlds, 14 pages/world) with hidden provenance graphs. Hybrid BM25+MiniLM search, deterministic metrics (FBAR/CUR/EAS/PCR/ICS/SER/PSR/PRR/CI/TUA/calibration/cost), clustered bootstrap CIs, sealed test split (480 worlds). This release is the paper-grade MVP (dev split, 10 frontier configs, Docker, analysis figures). See paper/main.pdf and PREREG.md.
